collection.title: Play 100
collection.scope: Mainstream AAA / blockbuster / major-publisher flagship games, plus a small number of AAA-caliber premium exceptions that clearly belong in an essential modern-gaming list. Nintendo excluded.
collection.rankingBasis: Curated must-play ranking, not a raw Metacritic leaderboard. Critical acclaim, lasting reputation, industry influence, cultural impact, design quality, production ambition and “must-play” status.

games.title: Red Dead Redemption 2
games.rationale: The benchmark blockbuster: world-building, immersion, narrative detail and systemic depth at extraordinary scale.

games.title: Mass Effect 2
games.rationale: Elite character-driven sci-fi RPG design; squad relationships and mission structure remain genre-defining.

games.title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
games.rationale: A landmark open-world RPG with exceptional side quests, world density and long-term reputation.

games.title: God of War
games.rationale: Major reinvention of a flagship action series with strong combat, presentation and character writing.

games.title: The Last of Us
games.rationale: A landmark cinematic action game with unusually strong pacing, performances and environmental storytelling.

games.title: Grand Theft Auto V
games.rationale: One of the defining blockbuster open worlds; huge cultural footprint and exceptional sandbox freedom.

games.title: Grand Theft Auto IV
games.rationale: Massive cultural impact and a more grounded crime-world tone that influenced open-world design.

games.title: Red Dead Redemption
games.rationale: Outstanding western open world and a foundational Rockstar story experience.

games.title: BioShock
games.rationale: A landmark AAA shooter/narrative hybrid whose setting, atmosphere and storytelling still stand out.

games.title: Mass Effect
games.rationale: Established BioWare's galaxy-scale RPG formula and the Commander Shepard trilogy foundation.

games.title: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim
games.rationale: Defining open-world fantasy RPG freedom; exploration, modding and scale made it a lasting gateway RPG.

games.title: Baldur's Gate 3
games.rationale: A modern RPG landmark for player choice, reactivity, companions, encounter design and systemic freedom.

games.title: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33
games.rationale: Exceptional modern RPG breakout: distinctive world, music, story and an innovative turn-based/action hybrid. AAA-caliber presentation despite an indie-sized studio.

games.title: Batman: Arkham City
games.rationale: The standout Batman game and a benchmark for open-world superhero action.

games.title: Elden Ring
games.rationale: Modern action-RPG landmark with huge exploration freedom and influential world design.

games.title: Uncharted 4: A Thief's End
games.rationale: AAA cinematic adventure polished to an exceptional degree, with superb set pieces and production value.

games.title: God of War Ragnarök
games.rationale: Refined sequel that expands the 2018 formula while delivering some of the strongest modern blockbuster combat.

games.title: The Last of Us Part II
games.rationale: Bold sequel with elite production, combat depth and unusually ambitious storytelling.

games.title: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas
games.rationale: An enormous cultural landmark and one of the strongest examples of early 3D open-world freedom.

games.title: Mass Effect 3
games.rationale: Excellent RPG systems, companions and galaxy-scale storytelling despite a divisive finale.

games.title: Fallout 3
games.rationale: A foundational modern open-world RPG with exploration, questing and atmosphere still worth experiencing.

games.title: Baldur's Gate II: Shadows of Amn
games.rationale: One of the foundational large-scale RPGs; less modern-looking, but massively important to the genre.

games.title: Halo 3
games.rationale: One of the defining console FPS campaigns and a major multiplayer-era blockbuster.

games.title: Portal 2
games.rationale: One of the strongest puzzle/adventure productions ever released by a major studio.

games.title: Half-Life 2
games.rationale: A transformative FPS that reshaped physics, environmental storytelling and immersive level design.

games.title: Cyberpunk 2077
games.rationale: An ambitious, visually striking RPG whose post-launch evolution is important to its legacy.

games.title: Resident Evil 4
games.rationale: A benchmark survival-horror remake: masterful pacing, encounter design and combat that sharpen an all-time classic.

games.title: Alan Wake 2
games.rationale: A landmark modern horror production with exceptional audiovisual direction and narrative ambition.

games.title: Control

games.title: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic

games.title: Metal Gear Solid 3: Snake Eater

games.title: Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare

games.title: Assassin's Creed IV: Black Flag
games.rationale: Combines Assassin's Creed with a highly memorable open-world naval sandbox.

games.title: Dishonored

games.title: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion

games.title: Halo: Reach

games.title: Far Cry 4

games.title: Dragon Age: Inquisition

games.title: Metro Exodus

games.title: Resident Evil 2

games.title: Resident Evil Requiem

games.title: Titanfall 2

games.title: Star Wars Battlefront II

games.title: Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice

games.title: Bloodborne

games.title: Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order

games.title: Horizon Zero Dawn

games.title: Horizon Forbidden West

games.title: Ghost of Tsushima

games.title: DOOM Eternal

games.title: Star Wars Jedi: Survivor

games.title: Final Fantasy XV

games.title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2
